table.ruleA: Add each compartment's Fill Table amount for the cycle to its contents; volume not enforced.
table.ruleB: Add each stage's Charge input table amount for the cycle to its charge; rated charge not enforced.

table.ruleA: Sequential 1..6; if contents > volume, excess goes to n+1 (already present when n+1 is checked, so it cascades), contents set to volume; equal or less does nothing; excess from 6 goes overboard to Total Overboard.
table.ruleB: Sequential 1..6; if charge > rated charge, excess goes to n+1 (already present when n+1 is checked, cascades), charge set to rated; equal or less does nothing; excess from 6 goes to ground total.

table.ruleA: Read contents after Step 2. LAMINAR becomes CAVITATING if contents are ABOVE (strictly >) the inception mark. CAVITATING becomes LAMINAR if contents at most (<=) the desinence mark. Contents above desinence and at or below inception keep state. Log changes, at most one per cycle.
table.ruleB: Read charge after Step 2. CLEAR becomes ASSERTED if charge is AT LEAST (>=) the upper mark. ASSERTED becomes CLEAR if charge at most (<=) lower mark. Charge strictly between lower and upper keeps state. Log changes, at most one per cycle.
table.difference: Turn-on threshold equality: A requires contents > inception mark; B requires charge >= upper mark. A position sitting exactly on the mark switches in B but not in A. (A's Definitions line says cavitation 'begins at the inception mark', but its operative Step 3 rule and its 'at or below inception keeps state' clause both say strictly above.) Turn-off rule (<= lower/desinence) is identical.

table.ruleA: Simultaneous: compute all amounts from contents at start of step using post-Step-3 state; LAMINAR quarter rounded down goes overboard; CAVITATING half rounded down backflows to n-1, from compartment 1 goes overboard; volume not enforced.
table.ruleB: Simultaneous: compute all amounts from charge at start of step using post-Step-3 state; CLEAR quarter rounded down to ground; ASSERTED half rounded down to n-1 via return diode, from stage 1 to ground; rated charge not enforced.

table.ruleA: Sum all six; if total > 38 (equality does not fire), every compartment becomes floor(half), removed units (contents minus floor half, i.e. the larger half on odd) go overboard; log cycle. Applies to all six.
table.ruleB: Sum all six; if total > 38 strictly, every stage becomes floor(half), removed charge to ground; log cycle. Applies to all six.

table.ruleA: End contents 1-6, end pump states, state change log (cycle, compartment, before, after), emergency blow cycles or none, Total Overboard, balance check.
table.ruleB: End charges 1-6, end comparator states, state change log (cycle, stage, before, after) in order, breaker trip cycles or never, ground total, balance check.
